about: What Station Player's Home page suggests under the title below. Edit this file on GitHub (player/station_player/static/picks.json): players pick up the change within the hour. Each pick needs a title and a station (its stream link). Optional: text, button (the button's words), image (a picture in the picks folder beside this file, e.g. picks/breakfast.png), from and to (24-hour local time; a pick with from 22:00 and to 06:00 runs overnight), days (mon tue wed thu fri sat sun), starts and ends (dates, YYYY-MM-DD). A pick with no times shows all day. The sport list is the stations the globe's Sport switch always shows, as well as the ones the directory finds: each needs a name, and either a station (its stream link, with lat and lon for where it goes on the globe) or nothing else, so it's looked up by name in Radio Browser (find gives a different name to look up). country (two letters, like GB) keeps it to stations from there, and lat and lon place it.
